name: Triple Ex
source:
He had it all... A career he loved and a family he loved even more. With a split-second decision, he lost them both, along with his freedom.

In Triple Ex, you follow Jake Miles. After his life finally returns to a sense of normality, recent events on the opposite side of the world will once again throw his life into turmoil.

Follow him on his adventures and discoveries as he struggles with family, emotions and to protect the people he loves.

[From [url=https://azrayal.itch.io/triple-ex]Itch.io[/url]]
